findings.title: Health API has variable backend latency, but phase culprit is unproven
findings.evidence: 30/30 HTTP 200 in each path; direct local p95 2.215s and max 2.995s; internal health.* metrics unavailable
findings.recommendation: Make existing sanitized runtime phase summaries retrievable through the authenticated internal system-status/runtime boundary, with bounded percentiles and no raw errors.

findings.title: Reverse proxy is not the dominant latency source in this sample
findings.evidence: Public HTTPS p95 0.392s versus direct local p95 2.215s; proxy connect p95 2.3ms
findings.recommendation: Do not optimize proxy time first; repeat paired measurements after phase telemetry is available.

findings.title: Rollback rate remains high without lock/deadlock evidence
findings.evidence: 15.03min: 4383 rollbacks, 291.53/min, 29.42% of transactions, zero deadlocks and zero lock waits at both snapshots
findings.recommendation: Add bounded termination-class attribution around transaction/autocommit boundaries; retain lane, duration, outcome class, and sanitized error code only.

findings.title: Write-heavy lanes create database churn context
findings.evidence: During window: flight +3163 updates, flightPosition +3157 inserts, predictiveObservation +3763 inserts, receiverCoverageHourly +1671 updates
findings.recommendation: Use the new attribution before changing persistence cadence; consider batching/coalescing only after lane failure rates are known.

findings.title: Node process shows sustained resource pressure
findings.evidence: 67 stable-PID samples: CPU average 72.32%, p95 76.5%; RSS average 1363.8MiB, max 1587.9MiB
findings.recommendation: Expose event-loop lag/GC and heap/RSS history through existing internal telemetry, then profile only in an approved maintenance window.

limitations: No authenticated internal diagnostics session was available.
pg_stat_statements is not installed and was not changed.
No event-loop or GC metric is safely exposed to this audit.
Health samples were sequential local/public probes, not concurrent load.
